method: original DPE (15-head IsoMax+ prototype ensemble with covariance regularization, equal probability averaging)
purpose: Original DPE Stage 1+ head training on saved Stage-0 backbone and canonical v1 test prediction export for multi-method failure-case comparison

execution.invocation: Executed Stage 1+ 15-head prototype training from notebooks/dpe_waterbirds_end_to_end.ipynb with capture_notebook_heads, saved heads via save_dpe_heads, packaged features via package_notebook_features, and exported predictions via export_dpe_heads

attempts.note: Trained all 15 prototype heads on pre-extracted validation embeddings (seed=0), saved outputs/dpe_seed0_heads.pt, and exported test predictions.

dataset.stage1_data_use: Each of the 15 heads is trained on a freshly drawn group-balanced subset of the 1,199 validation embeddings (4 * min_group_size = 4 * 133 = 532 examples per stage) and selected by full-validation (1,199 examples) worst-group accuracy.
dataset.group_mapping: group = 1 + 2*y + a (1: Landbird on Land, 2: Landbird on Water, 3: Waterbird on Land, 4: Waterbird on Water)

randomness.seed_initialization: utils.misc.fix_random_seed(0) called once before Stage 1; subsequent balanced-subset draws and DataLoader shuffles advance the RNG sequentially across stages 1..15.

selection.validation_use: Group-annotated validation split (1,199 examples) used both for group-balanced head-training subsampling (532 examples/stage) and per-epoch head selection (1,199 examples), matching the upstream DPE codebase and notebook.

assessment.claim_scope: Newly fitted 15-head DPE ensemble (seed 0) on the retained Stage-0 backbone checkpoint (checkpoints/dpe_ckpt_last.zip) for per-example failure-case comparison. Achieves 93.93% test WGA and 95.75% overall test accuracy (paper annotated ERM* DPE reference: 94.1 +/- 0.4% WGA).
limitations: Historical Kaggle runs did not save Stage 1+ head weights; these 15 heads were newly trained on local CPU (seed 0) using the notebook Stage 1+ recipe.
missing_evidence: Original Kaggle Stage 1+ in-memory head weights from 2026-11-02 were not persisted.
